import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv")

# Pivot to wide format: rows = city_id/year, columns = indicator_id, values = value
pivot_df = df.pivot(
    index=["city_id", "city_name", "year"],
    columns="indicator_id",
    values="value"
)

# Reset index to make city_id, city_name, year regular columns
pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

# Flatten column MultiIndex (indicator_id columns)

# Sort columns: city_id, city_name, year first, then indicator columns alphabetically
